argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root='E:\pc-github-relay'
if (!(Test-Path $root)) { throw "relay repo not found: $root" }
Get-ChildItem $root -Recurse -File -Include *.py,*.md,*.json -ErrorAction Stop |
  Select-String -Pattern 'uia\.inspect|uia\.focus|uia\.invoke|uia\.set_value|vision\.target\.invoke' |
  Select-Object -First 80 Path,LineNumber,Line | Format-List

note: Read local pc-control relay implementation/docs to learn UIA action parameter schemas
